events.body:
NS-0 routes this case through the rider-cancellation branch: the record shows cancelled_by = rider at 18:25:30, 2 min 30 s after acceptance, with a $6.61 cancellation fee on record [F2], so NS-4 governs and NS-1/NS-2 do not apply (the driver never pressed "I'm Here", and driver_pressed_here_at is null) [F3][F4].

NS-4: an on-demand ride cancelled within 3 minutes of matching is not chargeable; only a cancellation after 3 minutes makes the $6.61 fee valid [F2][F5]. The trace settles the timing element ✗ — 150 s after acceptance — so the fee does not become payable. The rider-cancellation fee therefore fails its own condition and the whole $6.61 must be returned: amount = $6.61 per the trace formula for a rider-cancellation case [F2][F5][NS-4].

The rider's reason (driver far away) is not what decides this: the driver's closest approach was 1816 m and he never entered the 200 m pickup radius [F1][F3], and the driver's chat said "5 min more, traffic is slow" [F8]. But NS-4 needs no fault on the driver's part — the fee simply is not chargeable inside the 3-minute window [F2][NS-4]. Traffic on Jurong East Avenue 1 (speed band 4) and the absence of incidents are irrelevant to the timing test [F11][F12][NS-4].

RIDER: You cancelled this ride about two and a half minutes after a driver accepted it. Under our cancellation rules, a fee isn't charged when you cancel that soon after matching, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded to you as a Ryde voucher. Nothing else changes on your account, and no action is being taken against you. You don't need to do anything — the voucher will be issued to your account. Thanks for riding with Ryde.

DRIVER: The rider cancelled this trip about two and a half minutes after you accepted it. Under our cancellation rules, a rider cancellation fee isn't payable when the ride is cancelled that soon after matching, so the $6.61 fee is being refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher. This wasn't a decision about your driving or your service — you weren't found at fault, and no action is being taken against your account. You don't need to do anything. Thanks for driving with Ryde.
